title: 「Stripping」簡化附和結構

omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 236; it is assigned system ID ss237 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: Complete clause + conjunction + new element + too / either / neither / nor structure

formulas.formula: Complete positive clause + and + subject + too
Negative clause + and neither + auxiliary + subject / nor + auxiliary + subject
Complete positive clause + and + new element + too
Negative clause + or + new element + either

example: I liked the first version, and she too.
exampleZh: 我喜歡第一個版本，她也是。

examples.en: I liked the first version, and she too.
examples.zh: 我喜歡第一個版本，她也是。
examples.highlight: I liked the first version, and she too.

meaning.zh: 這個句型省略第二部分與第一部分相同的內容，只保留新的主語、受詞、地點、時間或其他焦點。

rules.zh: 只有完全相同的內容才可以省略。 Correct: Amy enjoyed the concert, and Ben too. Amy 和 Ben 都是 enjoyed the concert，所以第二次可以省略。 Incorrect: Amy enjoyed the concert, and Ben the film too. 兩人的受詞不同，不能把所有內容都當作相同資料省略。
rules.en: Remove only information that is genuinely repeated. If the object or other meaning changes, do not strip away content needed to show that difference.

rules.zh: 肯定句使用： and + remaining element + too Examples: Mia joined the course, and Leo too. We visited London, and Paris too.
rules.en: Use too in affirmative structures: and + remaining element + too.

rules.zh: 當第二部分保留的是主語時，使用： and neither + auxiliary verb + subject 或： nor + auxiliary verb + subject Examples: She does not drive, and neither do I. He was not invited; nor was his colleague.
rules.en: For negative subject agreement, use and neither + auxiliary + subject or nor + auxiliary + subject.

rules.zh: 當第二部分保留的是受詞、地點或時間時，通常使用： or + remaining element + either Example: The report did not discuss costs, or safety either. （報告沒有討論成本，也沒有討論安全問題。）
rules.en: For a negative non-subject remainder, normally use or + remaining element + either.

rules.zh: 否定主語附和中的助動詞，必須配合第一句的時態和動詞形式。 First clause 第一部分 Agreement structure 附和結構 does not neither does do not neither do did not neither did is not neither is was not neither was has not neither has have not neither have had not neither had cannot neither can will not neither will would not neither would should not neither should Examples: Leo did not complain, and neither did Maya. The machine is not working, and neither is the printer. We have not received the email, and neither has Daniel.
rules.en: Match the auxiliary carefully to the tense and verb form of the first clause.

rules.zh: Neither 或 nor 後面使用主格代名詞。正確：Neither will I. Neither did she. Neither can they. 錯誤：Neither will me. Neither did her.
rules.en: Use subject pronouns after neither or nor: “Neither will I”, not “Neither will me.”

rules.zh: 不要使用 too 表示否定附和。錯誤：He does not agree, and I too. 正確：He does not agree, and neither do I.
rules.en: Do not use too for negative agreement; use neither or nor with the appropriate auxiliary.

rules.zh: 正確而簡潔，但語氣通常比 and she did too 稍為正式。 本練習專門訓練較短的省略形式。）
rules.en: The positive stripped form is concise but slightly formal. “I liked the first version, and she too” is shorter and more carefully written than “and she did too.”

benefits.zh: 你不需要把相同的動詞和資料再寫一次，只需保留新的重點。 Compare: Amy enjoyed the concert, and Ben enjoyed the concert too. Amy enjoyed the concert, and Ben too. 第二句較短，但意思仍然完整。
benefits.en: It avoids unnecessary repetition by stating shared information once and leaving only the new element.

benefits.zh: 讀者可以立即看出哪些內容相同，以及句子加入了哪一個人物、物件、地點或時間。
benefits.en: It makes comparisons easier to follow because the reader can immediately see what remains the same and what is added.

benefits.zh: 在這類句子中，最後保留下來的部分會成為句子的焦點。
benefits.en: It gives special attention to the new element left in the shortened second part.

benefits.zh: 使用這些結構，你可以表示另一個人同樣不做某事，而不用重複整句。
benefits.en: It provides a natural way to express negative agreement without repeating the complete sentence.

benefits.zh: 除了反覆使用 also、as well、both A and B 或兩句完整句子外，你可以使用這個較精簡的附和 結構，令句式更多樣。
benefits.en: It creates sentence variety beyond repeated use of also, as well, both A and B, neither A nor B or two complete sentences.

Preserve the original meaning and follow the supplied first word or opening.
